headline: Injective Asks SEC to Allow Order Books for Tokenized Stock Trading
summary: Developer Injective has petitioned the U.S. SEC to permit order-book systems for tokenized stock trading, arguing that existing regulatory rules unfairly favor single types of blockchain trading platforms.
why: Regulatory allowances for order-book models on decentralized networks could revolutionize how tokenized equities and traditional securities are traded cross-border.

impacts.name: Injective
impacts.why: Regulatory approval would expand compliant market access for blockchain-based order books.
